title: Syrian Vegetable Gratin with Oozing Cheese
description: A flavorful, comforting gratin featuring roasted vegetables and a rich, oozing cheese topping.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it's lightly browned and caramelized, about 20-25 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.

In a separate saucepan, combine the sliced gratin and enough cold water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the gratin is slightly softened.
In a large, shallow baking dish, create a layer of the onion mixture. Arrange a layer of the cooked gratin on top, followed by a sprinkle of shredded cheese.
Repeat the layering process two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Transfer the baking dish to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is bubbly.
Remove the gratin from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley. Serve hot.
